purpose: Define who must be able to discover ONS metadata through OKF, the decisions they make, and the journeys sampled by the public AI-client harness.
scope_boundary: These journeys evaluate metadata discovery, differentiation, provenance and query planning. They do not validate ONS observations, estimates or statistical interpretations.

source_material.role: ONS-specific confusable-dataset intents and contrast requirements
Generic OKF Explorer persona and journey precedent
MCP-Geo geospatial and ONS persona precedent

personas.title: Policy and research analyst
personas.goal: Find the statistical product that answers a policy question and explain why it is preferable to plausible alternatives.
decision_risks: selecting a familiar but differently defined series
using the wrong frequency, population or reference period

personas.title: Government statistician or methodologist
personas.goal: Confirm the exact measure, population, geography, frequency, edition and version while retaining methodology and quality boundaries.
decision_risks: treating related products as statistically equivalent
silently accepting an obsolete or mismatched version
confusing evidence availability with fitness or accuracy

personas.title: Data engineer and MCP integrator
personas.goal: Resolve stable source-qualified identifiers and produce a complete, inspectable selection plan without inventing dimensions or credentials.
decision_risks: executing a query before version and options are validated

personas.title: Data governance and standards assessor
personas.goal: Trace declared standards, provenance and licence evidence while keeping alignment, evaluation and certification distinct.
decision_risks: calling a vocabulary mapping compliance certification
omitting the scope or currency of evidence
treating generated metadata as the authoritative statistical source

personas.title: Geography and area analyst
personas.goal: Choose statistics and boundary products with the correct geography level, code family and vintage.
decision_risks: selecting a national product for an area question
treating geography labels as interchangeable identifiers

personas.title: AI evaluation operator
personas.goal: Run comparable client trials with known access controls, evidence fidelity, task outcomes and efficiency telemetry.
decision_risks: scoring a readiness failure as a wrong answer
calling estimated or partial telemetry exact
attributing a host/model combination difference to a client alone

journeys.title: Establish what the bundle is before searching
steps: Open the declared descriptor rather than infer that OKF is an installed package.
Read corpus scope, source lanes, metadata-only boundary and assurance caveats.
Choose the declared search, record and standards entrypoints.
success_criteria: No package-manager or generic web search is needed to discover the supplied bundle.
The answer states that the demonstrator is not the complete ONS corpus.
The answer does not claim statistical accuracy or standards certification.

journeys.title: Turn a human intent into a bounded candidate set
steps: Extract measure, population, geography, time and frequency constraints from the question.
Search metadata using the supplied terms and filters.
Return a small source-qualified candidate set before selecting a record.
success_criteria: The intended record is present at the evaluated cutoff when represented.
Candidates expose stable IDs and source surfaces.
No first-record convenience choice is presented as a completed search.

journeys.title: Expose plausible alternatives and decisive contrasts
steps: Keep the intended record and plausible alternatives in the reduced set.
Compare the fields that make the products non-interchangeable.
State when a cross-source match is reconciliation evidence rather than equivalence.
success_criteria: Required alternatives are exposed by their declared cutoff.
Every alternative has a source-qualified ID and material contrast.
Shared table codes are not treated as proof of statistical equivalence.

journeys.title: Hydrate the selected record without downloading a corpus shard
steps: Resolve the exact stable record ID from search.
Retrieve the complete single-record metadata.
Cite identity, provenance, version and material quality evidence.
success_criteria: The selected record is completely hydrated under the 65,536-byte constraint.
The route is declared rather than guessed.
The cited source and JSON pointers belong to the selected record.

journeys.title: Assess standards and quality evidence without certification language
steps: Inspect the standards register and its declared normative status and currency.
Trace mappings to record evidence and provenance.
Separate available evidence, bundle alignment and independent certification.
success_criteria: The answer preserves alignment-not-certification and accuracy-not-evaluated caveats.
Legal, policy and technical standards are not collapsed into one compliance score.
Every worked example names the exact record used.

journeys.title: Prepare, but do not execute, a validated MCP hand-off
steps: Copy native dataset, edition and version identifiers from the exact record.
Name the inspection and query tools declared for that source.
Leave unresolved dimensions explicit and record that no query ran.
success_criteria: No dimension, option, geography or credential is invented.
An incomplete plan cannot be labelled executable.
The selection plan is reproducible and bound to the exact record.

journeys.title: Handle access and hydration failures honestly
steps: Classify whether the failure belongs to client readiness, access policy or bundle contract.
Retry only through a declared path that respects the task constraints.
Abstain or label a substitute with its exact identity, reason and limitations.
success_criteria: A convenient first record is never presented as the requested record.
A host access failure is not described as proof that the bundle is unavailable.
Blocked and degraded outcomes remain visible and are not silently scored as success.

journeys.title: Capture a comparable, evidence-backed result
steps: Submit the visible answer and structured selection without hidden reasoning.
Record host, resolved model, access arm, capture fidelity and exact known telemetry.
Keep unknown or estimated token and byte measurements explicitly non-exact.
success_criteria: The result can be replayed and scored against the pinned public gold.
Efficiency claims name their denominator and comparison arm.
Readiness blocks and missing telemetry remain null rather than inferred.
